title: BoosterSimConnect: From Broken NWBrowser to Working Pulse Protocol Server
scope_summary: Post-incident retrospective on rewriting the network traffic inspection pipeline from NWBrowser client-mode discovery to NWListener server-mode (Bonjour-advertised TCP). Covers reverse-engineering the Pulse binary protocol, fixing an alignment crash in packet decoding, cross-platform iOS-framework-in-macOS-app embedding, and the full UI layer for traffic inspection. Includes root cause analysis and 5 lessons learned.
